spans.text: The First to Skulk are the “children” of Kitsune, though they aren’t technically related in a biological sense. They, along with the First to Consume, were originally ordinary foxes who were granted eternal life through reincarnation, and a form that resembled Luxux’ and her own. The First to Skulk are the progenitors of all kits’adria, and the most prevalent among them. They are considered demigods by many who tell stories of them.
